quality_reasons.text: Recognised retinal-detachment red flags (new floaters, flashes, curtain) and escalated urgently with clear instructions and an ED fallback
Verified identity and documented verbal permission before speaking to the son
Caught the steroid-drop frequency error by checking against discharge orders

decoys.text: Nurse discussed PHI with the son without authorization
decoys.why_not: Patient explicitly gave verbal permission, the nurse confirmed and documented it before speaking with the son.
decoys.evidence: you're giving me permission to discuss your care with your son, Jules?

decoys.why_not: They were escalated immediately (on-call ophthalmologist within the hour, ED fallback).
decoys.evidence: That needs to be seen by an eye doctor within the hour.

acceptable_flags.text: Possible retinal detachment after surgery (clinical risk, handled)
Steroid drop frequency error at home

Correct prednisolone to four times daily on the home chart

subtle_facts.text: Raised at the very end: copay paid at the desk Tuesday, then ClearPay portal charged $40 again
subtle_facts.evidence: that ClearPay portal charged him again yesterday

subtle_facts.text: Prednisolone was being given 3x/day at home instead of the prescribed 4x/day
